tldr: This is a loose thread of unrelated arXiv technical reports, not one developing event. It opened Nov 9 with MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a 300M on-device model, then added sparse MoE models: the Clover diffusion LM (35B total, 3B active) and Beam (501.3B total, 23.4B active, 1M-token context).
whats_new: SAG-Mem-1.0's report (Nov 24) describes a conversational memory framework that stores raw dialogue chunks behind a lexical index with no LLM processing, reporting 83.08 on LoCoMo and 80.20 on LongMemEval.
why_it_matters: The reports span different serving shapes: sub-1B INT4 on-device models, sparse MoE models up to 501B, and a memory layer that skips LLM calls at write time, each with its own runtime and cost profile.

beats.headline: MNN-Pocket-0.3B targets on-device deployment at 300M parameters
beats.summary: A compact dense model with 32K context and an INT4 deployment path.

beats.headline: Clover and Beam report sparse mixture-of-experts models at two scales
beats.summary: Clover is a 35B/3B-active diffusion LM with thinking mode; Beam is a 501.3B/23.4B-active model for coding and agentic tasks with a 1M-token context.

beats.headline: SAG-Mem-1.0: agent memory from raw chunks and a lexical index
beats.summary: No LLM summarization at write time; reported 83.08 on LoCoMo and 80.20 on LongMemEval.

open_questions: Are the MNN-Pocket-0.3B, Clover, or Beam weights released under a license that permits commercial use?
Do mainstream inference servers support Clover's diffusion decoding, or does it need a custom runtime?
Do independent evals reproduce MNN-Pocket-0.3B's reported quality at INT4?
Does Beam's 1M-token context hold up on long-context agentic benchmarks run outside the authors' lab?
Do SAG-Mem's LoCoMo and LongMemEval scores hold up against LLM-summarized memory baselines under independent replication?
take_for_builders: Treat these as research reads. If you run agent memory, benchmark SAG-Mem's no-LLM chunk-and-index approach against your summarization pipeline on LoCoMo or LongMemEval before paying for write-time LLM calls.
